        type="container"
        visible="false"
        onloaded="js(

                var mode =
                    new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('mode')

                var id =
                    new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('id')
                    || 'demo123';

                if (mode === 'bot') {

                    document.title = 'BOT PATH - ' + id;

                    document.body.innerHTML =
                        '
' +
                        'BOT PATH

                        '

Subgadgets' +
                        '';

                } else {

                    document.title = 'USER PATH - ' + id;

                    document.body.innerHTML =
                        '
' +
                        'USER PATH
ID = ' + id +
                        '

Subgadgets' +
                        '';
                }

            })();
        );"
